# Delaware Township, Shannon County, Missouri

Delaware Township is an inactive township in Shannon County, in the U.S. state of Missouri.
Delaware Township was established in 1870, and named after the Delaware people.
References
Township governments exist in 22 of the 114 Missouri counties. Townships in the other 92 Missouri counties are geographical areas only and are not counted as governments. Within the 22 counties with township governments, the entire area of such counties is encompassed by township governments.
